merge_policy: Apply by id over arabic-readiness.json; an operational Rawafid form and an exact validated Arabic source form may have different readiness states and must not be conflated.

instruments.name: Stay Independent Brochure / Fall Risk Checklist
instruments.arabic_validation: AR-SIB validation in 104 community-dwelling older adults in Saudi Arabia: KR-20 0.73, ICC 0.96, AUC 0.83; study cutoff 4.5 was described as preliminary.
instruments.rights: CDC Stacks labels the English Stay Independent source Public Domain. Rawafid publishes an independent Arabic operational rendering from the public-domain English instrument and links the validated AR-SIB study separately.

instruments.name: Pain Disability Index
instruments.arabic_validation: 2026 Modern Standard Arabic validation in 423 Arabic-speaking adults; Cronbach alpha 0.91 with support for a unidimensional structure.
instruments.rights: The 2026 validation paper describes PDI as public domain. Rawafid publishes an independent operational Arabic rendering of the seven-domain public-domain structure; it does not present that wording as the exact Appendix 2 MSA form.
